title: Email performance
intro: Unique tracked messages queued during the selected UTC dates. Queued is the cohort total, including messages already sent. Outcomes can arrive after the period ends.
invalidRange: Choose a date range of 1–90 days.
loadFailed: Email performance could not be loaded.
empty: No tracked emails were queued in this period
noteCounting: Each outcome counts a message once, even when an event repeats. Delivery and opens require provider event tracking; historical emails are not backfilled.
noteApproximation: Opens are approximate because mail privacy features and image blocking affect them. Automated link scanners may count as clicks. Confirmed goals use a seven-day last CTA click association with a recorded product action by the same user in the same organization.
noteAttribution: Attributed conversions describe recorded follow-through, not causal lift. Revenue is not shown because conversion values do not yet have a verified currency contract.
